summary: Physiology: Modern Cell Biology Using Microscopic, Biochemical and Computational Approaches is an advanced research training course at the Marine Biological Laboratory (MBL) in Woods Hole, Massachusetts, United States. It covers modern cell biology through microscopic, biochemical and computational approaches. The 2027 course runs from 13 June to 25 July 2027, and applications are due by 10 February 2027.
highlights: Onsite course in Woods Hole, Massachusetts, from 13 June to 25 July 2027.
